using Base.Threads
using JSON
using ArgParse

function chain_dir_to_fasta(dir::String)
    alignment_file_types = ["mgnify_hits.a3m", "uniref90_hits.a3m", "bfd_uniclust_hits.a3m"]
    alignment_file = ""
    for aft in alignment_file_types
        af = joinpath(dir, aft)
        if isfile(af)
            alignment_file = af
            break
        end
    end
    seq = ""
    open(alignment_file, "r") do f
        readline(f)
        seq = strip(readline(f))
        try
            next_line = readline(f)
            @assert startswith(next_line, ">")
        catch
        end
    end
    chain_id = basename(dir)
    return ">" * chain_id * "\n" * seq * "\n"
end

function index_entry_to_fasta(index_entry::Dict{String, Any}, db_dir::String, chain_id::String)
    db_file = joinpath(db_dir, index_entry["db"])
    alignment_file_types = ["mgnify_hits.a3m", "uniref90_hits.a3m", "bfd_uniclust_hits.a3m"]
    start = 0
    size_bytes = 0
    for aft in alignment_file_types
        for fi in index_entry["files"]
            if fi[1] == aft
                start, size_bytes = fi[2], fi[3]
                break
            end
        end
        if size_bytes > 0
            break
        end
    end
    seq = ""
    open(db_file, "r") do f
        seek(f, start)
        data = read(f, size_bytes)
        msa_lines = split(String(data), "\n")
        if length(msa_lines) >= 2
            seq = msa_lines[2]
        end
        try
            if length(msa_lines) >= 3
                next_line = msa_lines[3]
                @assert startswith(next_line, ">")
            end
        catch
        end
    end
    return ">" * chain_id * "\n" * seq * "\n"
end

function main_fasta(output_path::String, alignment_db_index::Union{String, Nothing}, alignment_dir::Union{String, Nothing})
    fasta = String[]
    if alignment_dir !== nothing && alignment_db_index !== nothing
        error("Only one of alignment_db_index and alignment_dir can be provided.")
    end
    if alignment_dir !== nothing
        println("Creating FASTA from alignment directory...")
        chain_dirs = readdir(alignment_dir, join=true)
        n = length(chain_dirs)
        results = Vector{String}(undef, n)
        @threads for i in 1:n
            results[i] = chain_dir_to_fasta(chain_dirs[i])
        end
        append!(fasta, results)
    elseif alignment_db_index !== nothing
        println("Creating FASTA from alignment dbs...")
        open(alignment_db_index, "r") do f
            index = JSON.parse(f)
            db_dir = dirname(alignment_db_index)
            chain_ids = collect(keys(index))
            n = length(chain_ids)
            results = Vector{String}(undef, n)
            @threads for i in 1:n
                ie = index[chain_ids[i]]
                results[i] = index_entry_to_fasta(ie, db_dir, chain_ids[i])
            end
            append!(fasta, results)
        end
    else
        error("Either alignment_db_index or alignment_dir must be provided.")
    end
    open(output_path, "w") do f
        write(f, join(fasta, ""))
    end
    println("FASTA file written to $output_path.")
end

function main_extend_super_index(args)
    open(args["alignment_db_super_index_path"], "r") do fp
        super_index = JSON.parse(fp)
        open(args["all_chains_fasta"], "r") do fp2
            lines = readlines(fp2)
            chains_to_seqs = Dict{String, String}()
            for chain_idx in 1:2:length(lines)
                chain = strip(lines[chain_idx][2:end])
                seq = strip(lines[chain_idx + 1])
                chains_to_seqs[chain] = seq
            end
            chains_w_alignments = Set(keys(super_index))
            chains_wo_alignments = setdiff(keys(chains_to_seqs), chains_w_alignments)
            seq_to_chain_w_alignment = Dict(chains_to_seqs[chain] => chain for chain in chains_w_alignments)
            println("Unique sequences with alignments: ", length(seq_to_chain_w_alignment))
            remaining_unaligned_chains = String[]
            for chain in chains_wo_alignments
                seq = chains_to_seqs[chain]
                try
                    corresponding_alignment = super_index[seq_to_chain_w_alignment[seq]]
                    super_index[chain] = corresponding_alignment
                catch
                    push!(remaining_unaligned_chains, chain)
                end
            end
            open(args["output_path"], "w") do fp3
                JSON.print(fp3, super_index)
            end
            println("No corresponding alignment found for the following $(length(remaining_unaligned_chains)) chains: ", remaining_unaligned_chains)
        end
    end
end

function main_create_db(args)
    db_path = joinpath(args["output_db_path"], args["output_db_name"] * ".db")
    index_path = joinpath(args["output_db_path"], args["output_db_name"] * ".index")
    db_fp = open(db_path, "w")
    index = Dict{String, Any}()
    db_offset = 0
    for chain_alignment_dir in readdir(args["alignment_dir"])
        cad_path = joinpath(args["alignment_dir"], chain_alignment_dir)
        if !isdir(cad_path)
            continue
        end
        for f in readdir(cad_path)
            f_path = joinpath(cad_path, f)
            open(f_path, "r") do fp
                file_bytes = read(fp)
                l = length(file_bytes)
                file_list = get!(index, chain_alignment_dir, Any[])
                push!(file_list, (f, db_offset, l))
                index[chain_alignment_dir] = file_list
                write(db_fp, file_bytes)
                db_offset += l
            end
        end
    end
    close(db_fp)
    open(index_path, "w") do fp
        JSON.print(fp, index)
    end
end

function split_file_list(file_list::Vector{String}, n_shards::Int)
    split_list = [String[] for _ in 1:n_shards]
    for (i, f) in enumerate(file_list)
        push!(split_list[(i-1) % n_shards + 1], f)
    end
    return split_list
end

function chunked_iterator(lst::Vector, chunk_size::Int)
    chunks = []
    for i in 1:chunk_size:length(lst)
        push!(chunks, lst[i:min(i+chunk_size-1, length(lst))])
    end
    return chunks
end

function read_chain_dir(chain_dir::String)
    if !isdir(chain_dir)
        error("chain_dir must be a directory, but is $chain_dir")
    end
    chain_name = basename(chain_dir)
    file_data = Tuple{String, Vector{UInt8}}[]
    for file_path in sort(readdir(chain_dir, join=true))
        file_name = basename(file_path)
        open(file_path, "r") do file
            file_bytes = read(file)
            push!(file_data, (file_name, file_bytes))
        end
    end
    return Dict(chain_name => file_data)
end

function process_chunk(chain_files::Vector{String})
    chunk_data = Dict{String, Any}()
    n = length(chain_files)
    results = Vector{Dict{String, Any}}(undef, n)
    @threads for i in 1:n
        results[i] = read_chain_dir(chain_files[i])
    end
    for r in results
        merge!(chunk_data, r)
    end
    return chunk_data
end

function create_index_default_dict()
    return Dict("db" => nothing, "files" => Any[])
end

function create_shard(shard_files::Vector{String}, output_dir::String, output_name::String, shard_num::Int)
    CHUNK_SIZE = 200
    shard_index = Dict{String, Dict{String, Any}}()
    chunk_iter = chunked_iterator(shard_files, CHUNK_SIZE)
    output_path = joinpath(output_dir, output_name * "_$shard_num.db")
    db_offset = 0
    open(output_path, "w") do db_file
        for files_chunk in chunk_iter
            chunk_data = process_chunk(files_chunk)
            for (chain_name, file_data) in chunk_data
                if !haskey(shard_index, chain_name)
                    shard_index[chain_name] = create_index_default_dict()
                end
                shard_index[chain_name]["db"] = basename(output_path)
                for (file_name, file_bytes) in file_data
                    file_length = length(file_bytes)
                    push!(shard_index[chain_name]["files"], (file_name, db_offset, file_length))
                    write(db_file, file_bytes)
                    db_offset += file_length
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return shard_index
end

function main_create_sharded_db(args)
    alignment_dir = args["alignment_dir"]
    output_dir = args["output_db_path"]
    mkpath(output_dir)
    output_db_name = args["output_db_name"]
    n_shards = get(args, "n_shards", 10)
    n_cpus = Sys.CPU_THREADS
    if n_shards > n_cpus
        @warn "Warning: Your number of shards ($n_shards) is greater than the number of cores on your machine ($n_cpus). This may result in slower performance. Consider using a smaller number of shards."
    end
    println("Getting chain directories...")
    all_chain_dirs = sort(readdir(alignment_dir, join=true))
    chain_dir_shards = split_file_list(all_chain_dirs, n_shards)
    super_index = Dict{String, Any}()
    println("Creating $n_shards alignment-db files...")
    n = n_shards
    results = Vector{Dict{String, Any}}(undef, n)
    @threads for i in 1:n
        results[i] = create_shard(chain_dir_shards[i], output_dir, output_db_name, i)
    end
    for r in results
        merge!(super_index, r)
    end
    println("\nCreated all shards.")
    if haskey(args, "duplicate_chains_file") && args["duplicate_chains_file"] !== nothing
        println("Extending super index with duplicate chains...")
        duplicates_added = 0
        open(args["duplicate_chains_file"], "r") do fp
            duplicate_chains = [split(strip(line)) for line in readlines(fp)]
            for chains in duplicate_chains
                representative_chain = ""
                for chain in chains
                    if haskey(super_index, chain)
                        representative_chain = chain
                        break
                    end
                end
                if representative_chain == ""
                    println("No representative chain found for $chains, skipping...")
                    continue
                end
                for chain in chains
                    if chain != representative_chain
                        super_index[chain] = super_index[representative_chain]
                        duplicates_added += 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        println("Added $duplicates_added duplicate chains to index.")
    end
    println("\nWriting super index...")
    index_path = joinpath(output_dir, output_db_name * ".index")
    open(index_path, "w") do fp
        JSON.print(fp, super_index, 4)
    end
    println("Done.")
end

function main_merge_indices(args)
    super_index = Dict{String, Any}()
    for f in readdir(args["alignment_db_dir"])
        if splitext(f)[2] != ".index"
            continue
        end
        open(joinpath(args["alignment_db_dir"], f), "r") do fp
            index = JSON.parse(fp)
            db_name = splitext(f)[1] * ".db"
            for k in keys(index)
                super_index[k] = Dict("db" => db_name, "files" => index[k])
            end
        end
    end
    open(joinpath(args["output_dir"], "super.index"), "w") do fp
        JSON.print(fp, super_index)
    end
end

function create_duplicate_dirs(duplicate_chains::Vector{Vector{SubString{String}}}, alignment_dir::String)
    println("Creating duplicate directory symlinks...")
    dirs_created = 0
    for chains in duplicate_chains
        representative_chain = ""
        for chain in chains
            if isdir(joinpath(alignment_dir, chain))
                representative_chain = chain
                break
            end
        end
        if representative_chain == ""
            println("No representative chain found for $chains, skipping...")
            continue
        end
        for chain in chains
            if chain != representative_chain
                target_path = joinpath(alignment_dir, chain)
                if isdir(target_path)
                    println("Chain $chain already exists, skipping...")
                else
                    symlink(joinpath(alignment_dir, representative_chain), target_path)
                    dirs_created += 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    println("Created directories for $dirs_created duplicate chains.")
end

function main_create_duplicates(alignment_dir::String, duplicate_chains_file::String)
    open(duplicate_chains_file, "r") do fp
        duplicate_chains = [split(strip(line)) for line in readlines(fp)]
        alignment_dir_abs = abspath(alignment_dir)
        create_duplicate_dirs(duplicate_chains, alignment_dir_abs)
    end
end

function reformat_cluster_file(cluster_file::String, output_file::String)
    cluster_to_chains = Dict{String, Vector{String}}()
    open(cluster_file, "r") do f
        for line in readlines(f)
            line = strip(line)
            parts = split(line)
            if length(parts) < 2
                continue
            end
            cluster_name, chain_id = parts[1], parts[2]
            push!(get!(cluster_to_chains, cluster_name, String[]), chain_id)
        end
    end
    open(output_file, "w") do f
        for chains in values(cluster_to_chains)
            write(f, join(chains, " ") * "\n")
        end
    end
end

function main_cluster(args)
    input_file = abspath(args["input_fasta"])
    output_file = abspath(args["output_file"])
    output_dir = dirname(output_file)
    mmseqs_prefix = "_mmseqs_out"
    tmp_name = mmseqs_prefix * "_temp"
    tmp_dir = joinpath(output_dir, tmp_name)
    mkpath(tmp_dir)
    mmseqs_command = `$(args["mmseqs_binary_path"]) easy-cluster $input_file $mmseqs_prefix $tmp_name --min-seq-id $(args["seq-id"]) -c 0.9 -s 8 --max-seqs 1000 --cluster-mode 1`
    println("Running mmseqs2...")
    cd(output_dir) do
        run(mmseqs_command)
    end
    cluster_file = joinpath(output_dir, "_mmseqs_out_cluster.tsv")
    println("Reformatting output file...")
    reformat_cluster_file(cluster_file, output_file)
    println("Cleaning up mmseqs2 output...")
    mmseqs_outputs = [joinpath(output_dir, mmseqs_prefix * "_" * suffix) for suffix in ["cluster.tsv", "rep_seq.fasta", "all_seqs.fasta"]]
    for file in mmseqs_outputs
        if isfile(file)
            rm(file)
        end
    end
    if isdir(tmp_dir)
        rm(tmp_dir, recursive=true)
    end
    println("Done!")
end

function parse_args_cluster()
    s = ArgParseSettings()
    @add_arg_table s begin
        "input_fasta"
            help = "Input .fasta file. Sequence names should be in format >{PDB_ID}_{CHAIN_ID}"
            arg_type = String
            required = true
        "output_file"
            help = "Output file. Each line will contain a space-separated list of {PDB_ID}_{CHAIN_ID} belonging to the same cluster."
            arg_type = String
            required = true
        "mmseqs_binary_path"

            arg_type = String
            required = true
        "--seq-id"
            help = "Sequence identity threshold for clustering."
            arg_type = Float64
            default = 0.4
    end
    return parse_args(s)
end
